diagnostics.description: Diagnostic entries serialized from `ValidationDiagnostic` objects. Each entry contains `severity` (`error`, `warning` or `info`; `info` is counted in neither summary total), `path`, `schemaId?`, and `message`, plus `advisory: true` on advice-only diagnostics (the severity is unchanged) and `code?`, the stable rule identifier where the engine has one (the message text is unchanged).

RepoValidateSummary.description: Summary row in a repo validate payload. Mirrors `ValidationSummary` from srs-repository with a local type for JsonSchema.

advisories.description: Advisory diagnostics (advice only), a subset of `warnings`.
